A.notes: The core idea is clear and the product demo is relevant, but the page feels very close to a standard dark SaaS template rather than a distinct point of view. Desktop is mostly clean, yet the 375px experience has real horizontal overflow and clipped code/install UI, which materially hurts craft and responsive usability. The scroll-strip shows little evidence of motion doing storytelling beyond simple section progression; reduced-motion support appears present.

B.notes: This is the stronger execution: the hero, terminal/result pair, and three-step explanation all reinforce the same 'find the one line' story with good clarity. It is still somewhat benchmark-familiar, but the type scale, copy framing, and UI mock details are more confident and better resolved than A. The scroll-strip does not show especially meaningful motion, so Motion stays modest, but accessibility and responsive checks are solid.

raw.why: B is cleaner, more coherent, and more reliable at 375px, while A's mobile overflow is a significant quality drop.
